definitions.gloss: person of Japanese descent; Japanese emigrant or descendant
definitions.explanation: A person of Japanese ancestry living outside Japan, including Japanese emigrants and their descendants. Often used in the context of communities in Brazil, the United States, Peru, and other countries.

examples.japanese: ブラジルには{多|おお}くの{日系人|にっけいじん}がいる。
examples.english: There are many people of Japanese descent in Brazil.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{三世|さんせい}の{日系人|にっけいじん}で、{日本語|にほんご}も{話|はな}せる。
examples.english: He is a third-generation Japanese descendant and can also speak Japanese.

examples.japanese: {日系人|にっけいじん}のコミュニティは{世界|せかい}{各地|かくち}に{広|ひろ}がっている。
examples.english: Communities of people of Japanese descent are spread across the world.

notes:
USAGE:
{日系人|にっけいじん} refers specifically to people of Japanese ancestry living abroad. It does not refer to Japanese nationals living in Japan. Generations are indicated as {一世|いっせい} (first generation, the emigrant), {二世|にせい} (second), {三世|さんせい} (third), and so on.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日系人|にっけいじん}コミュニティ (Japanese-descent community)
- {日系人|にっけいじん}{社会|しゃかい} (Japanese-descent society)
- {日系|にっけい}{二世|にせい} (second-generation Japanese)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {日本人|にほんじん}: Japanese person (nationality)
- {在外|ざいがい}{邦人|ほうじん}: Japanese national living abroad
- {日系|にっけい}: of Japanese descent (prefix/modifier)
